subject.title: No guard against skill repos created outside canonical paths

question: Should OpenClaw add orphan `SKILL.md` detection outside configured skill roots, and should that run only in an explicit check or Doctor path?
rationale: The source gap is real, but scanning outside configured roots changes privacy, performance, false-positive, and startup-noise behavior, so maintainer intent is needed before implementation.

options.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
options.body: Add bounded orphan detection to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor with configured-root exclusions and clear remediation.

options.title: Startup Warning Too
options.body: Also warn during startup, accepting additional filesystem scanning and operator-visible noise.

options.title: Document Current Scope Only
options.body: Keep OpenClaw limited to configured roots and improve docs instead of adding off-root scanning.

recommendation.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
recommendation.body: Add bounded orphan detection to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor with configured-root exclusions and clear remediation.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses skill-creator, skills CLI, and workspace audit behavior where `steipete` has the strongest feature-history trail.
